name: Sheet Pan Cheesy Chicken Fajita Burritos THE SHEET PAN MEAL PREP SERIE
author: stealth_health_life
cap: Sheet Pan Cheesy Chicken Fajita Burritos THE SHEET PAN MEAL PREP SERIES EPISODE 1 Per Burrito (Makes 12) 445 Calories 42g Protein 35g Carbs 16g Fat —— Fajita Veggies 6 bell peppers, diced 2 onions, diced 15g (1 Tbsp) coarse salt Fajita Chicken: 1360g (48oz) boneless, skinless chicken thighs, diced 40g (2 Tbsp) tomato paste 30g (2 Tbsp) chili paste (harissa or adobo sauce) 3 packets taco seasoning 20g (1 ½ Tbsp) neutral oil Optional: oregano and chili powder, to taste Burrito Fillings: 280g (10oz) pico de gallo 150g (⅔ cup) 0% Greek yogurt 120g (1 cup) reduced-fat mozzarella cheese 80g (⅔ cup) reduced-fat cheddar cheese  Optional Topping 80g (⅔ cup) reduced-fat mozzarella (for melting on top) Chopped fresh cilantro, for garnish Assembly 12 @eatcounter burrito-sized protein tortillas* (or burrito sized tortillas of choice) Instructions 1.) Preheat oven to 425°F. On a large sheet pan, toss diced bell peppers and onions with coarse salt. Roast for 20-30 minutes, or until soft and moisture has mostly evaporated. 2.) Remove pan from oven. Add diced chicken thighs directly on top of the roasted veggies. Add tomato paste, chili paste, taco seasoning, oil, and optional spices. Mix everything together directly on the pan until well combined. 3.) Return pan to oven and roast for another 18-20 minutes, or until chicken is fully cooked. For extra browning, switch oven to broil for 2-3 minutes at the end. 4.) Remove from oven and immediately add pico de gallo, shredded mozzarella, cheddar, and Greek yogurt. Stir everything together on the pan until the cheese is melted and mixture is fully combined. 5.) Sprinkle additional mozzarella over the top and return to oven for 2-3 minutes to melt. Garnish with chopped cilantro. 6.) Use a spatula to divide the mixture on the pan into 12 evenly sized sections - these will be your burrito portions. 7.) Place one portion of filling in each burrito-sized tortilla and roll tightly. Wrap in foil or parchment and freeze for later. To reheat, wrap in a paper towel and microwave for 3-4 mins, air fry or pan fry after if you want a crispy tortilla. Enjoy! #stealthhealth #mealprep #sheetpan #sheetpanmealprep #sheetpanrecipes
tr: Welcome to my new series, The Sheet Pan Meal Prep, where I'm showing you how to use just one sheet pan to make high protein meals in bulk for almost no effort at all. Today we're making cheesy chicken fajita burritos. I pack 42 grams of protein each, only 445 calories. So for almost no effort at all, you get 12 cheesy chicken fajita burritos store frozen and have for meals for weeks. Let me show you how to make them. Start by adding diced onions and bell peppers to a sheet pan and add about a tablespoon of salt. Toss those in the oven to roast. Based off the instructions shown on screen. Add diced chicken thighs right over the top, along with tomato paste, chili paste, three packets of taco seasoning of choice, and a little bit of a neutral oil. Give it a mix until it's completely combined and all you have to do is toss that in the oven to cook. Based off the instructions shown on screen. Now all we have to do is add the toppings and give it a mix. I like to top it off with a little bit of extra mozzarella. Top off with your cilantro, use a spatula to cut it into about 12 equally sized rectangles, and then assemble the burritos. These are so easy to make and pack an insane amount of flavor. And if you make them, you'll have high protein lunches ready to go for weeks. Enjoy

blog: SKLADNIKI: 3  chicken breasts (cubed) | 2 tbsp olive oil | 4 cloves garlic (minced) | 2 tsp smoked paprika | 2 tsp garlic powder | 1 tsp dried parsley | 2 tsp salt | 1/2 tsp black pepper | 3 tbsp avocado oil (or oil of choice) | 2 tbsp butter | 1 tbsp honey | 2 tbsp freshly chopped parsley | 2 tbsp butter | 4 cloves garlic (minced) | 2 cups heavy cream | 1/2 cup freshly grated mozzarella | 1/2 cup freshly grated cheddar cheese | 12 oz elbow macaroni (cooked al dente) | 2 tsp smoked paprika | 2 tsp garlic powder | 2 tsp salt | 1/2 tsp black pepper || KROKI: Marinate the Chicken: In a large bowl, combine the cubed chicken with olive oil, garlic, smoked paprika, garlic powder, parsley, salt, and black pepper. Let it marinate for 10 minutes while you prepare the other ingredients. Cook the Chicken: Heat a large skillet over medium heat and add the marinated chicken. Cook for 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until fully cooked. Reduce the heat to low and stir in the butter, honey, and chopped parsley. Let it melt and coat the chicken, then set aside. Make the Mac & Cheese: In the same skillet, add butter to deglaze the pan over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and cook for 2-3 minutes until golden and fragrant. Cook the Pasta: Boil the elbow macaroni according to package instructions. Drain and rinse under cold water to prevent overcooking. Combine: Add the cooked pasta to the cheese sauce and let it simmer on low for about 5 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld. Serve & Store: Enjoy warm or divide into four airtight containers for meal prep. (Watch Video Below!)

blog: SKLADNIKI: 250 g bread flour | 50 g cake flour | 6 g instant dry yeast | 40 g sugar | 5 g salt | 1  egg | 140 g water | 30 g unsalted butter (softened) | 1  egg (for egg wash) | 1 tbsp milk (for egg wash) | sesame seeds (for topping) | 1.5 lb minced chicken | 1 tsp garlic powder | 1 tsp onion powder | 2 tsp salt | 1/2 tsp white pepper | 1/2 tsp MSG | 1 tsp sugar | 1 tbsp cornstarch | 1 cup all purpose flour | 1 cup all purpose flour | 1/4 cup cornstarch | 1 tsp baking powder | 1 tsp salt | 1/2 tsp MSG | 1 tsp white pepper | 1 tsp onion powder | 1 tsp garlic powder | 1 1/2 cups cold club soda (up to 2 cups (adjust based on consistency)) | 1/3 cup mayo | 4 tbsp relish | 3 tbsp ketchup | 1 tsp sugar | 1 tsp white vinegar | 1 lb ground beef (divided into 2.5 oz balls) | salt and pepper | 4 slices american cheese | iceberg lettuce (shredded) | 1/4 cup white onions (diced) | pickles | sesame buns || KROKI: In a mixing bowl, combine bread flour, cake flour, yeast, sugar, salt, egg, and water. Mix on low speed with a dough hook until a shaggy dough forms. Add softened butter and knead on medium speed for 10-15 minutes until smooth and elastic (passes the windowpane test). Shape dough into a ball, cover, and let rise until doubled in size (about 1 hour). Punch out air, divide into 6 balls (85-90g each), and shape them into smooth rounds. Let rest for 40 minutes until they increase in size by 1.5x. Preheat oven to 392°F. Whisk together egg and milk for an egg wash, brush over buns, and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Bake for about 10 minutes until golden brown. Let cool before slicing. In a bowl, mix minced chicken with garlic powder, onion powder, salt, white pepper, MSG, sugar, and cornstarch. Shape into nuggets and McChicken patties. Freeze on a parchment-lined tray for at least 30 minutes. Make the wet batter: Whisk together flour, cornstarch, baking powder, salt, MSG, white pepper, onion powder, garlic powder, and club soda. Heat oil to 350°F. Coat nuggets/patties in dry flour, then dip in wet batter, shaking off excess. Fry until golden brown. Drain on a paper towel. To make the McChicken, toast the bun, spread mayo on the bottom, add lettuce, fried chicken patty, and top with the bun. Mix mayo, relish, ketchup, sugar, and vinegar. Roll ground beef into 2.5 oz balls, season with salt and pepper, and smash on a hot griddle. Flip when seared, top with cheese, and cook until melted. Assemble the burger: Bottom bun, Big Mac sauce, lettuce, cheese patty, onions, middle bun, more sauce, lettuce, pickles, second patty, onions, and top bun. Enjoy your McDonald's at home! Pair the nuggets with the leftover Big Mac sauce for the ultimate experience :)

Add the garlic powder, oregano, freshly chopped parsley, and black pepper to the sauce. Stir well and adjust seasoning with additional salt and pepper, to taste. Toss in the cooked penne pasta and let everything simmer together for about 5 minutes, allowing the pasta to absorb the sauce and all the flavors to meld beautifully. Plate the creamy pesto pasta, and if desired, top with freshly grated Parmesan. Garnish with extra parsley for a fresh finish. Enjoy!

name: Cajun Chicken Alfredo
author: recipeincaption
cap: Cajun Chicken Alfredo 🤠 One of those recipes that feels like a restaurant flex but totally belongs in your weeknight dinner rotation. Spicy blackened chicken, garlicky cream sauce, and a motherload of parmesan… 🫵 Ingredients: -3 large chicken breasts, flattened  -1 tbsp olive oil -¾ lbs (340g) fettuccine  -4 tbsp cajun seasoning (store-bought or homemade blend below) -1 1/2 cups fresh parmesan cheese, grated -2 cups heavy cream, room temperature -1/4 cup cooking wine (optional) -Pasta water, as need -2 tbsp avocado oil (@chosenfoods) -1/2 cup butter -10 to 12 fresh garlic cloves, minced -Fresh parsley, chopped (optional) Homemade Cajun Seasoning: -2 tbsp paprika -1 tbsp garlic powder -1 tsp onion powder -1 tsp salt -1 tsp Italian seasoning -1 tsp black pepper -1–2 tsp cayenne pepper (bring the heat 👀) Instructions: 1. Cold chicken straight from the fridge = uneven cooking. Let it hang out on the counter while you prep. Flatten each breast slightly for even searing. 2. Drizzle 1 tbsp of olive oil over the chicken, then rub in 4 tbsp of your Cajun seasoning (store-bought or your spicy homemade blend). Make sure it's fully coated and looking bronzed like it just got back from Cabo. 3. Boil salted water and cook your fettuccine until just shy of al dente (check the box time, subtract a minute). Reserve a cup of pasta water, then drain and drizzle and toss with olive oil to prevent clumping. 4. In a large pan over medium-high heat, add 2 tbsp avocado oil. Once shimmering, add your chicken breasts and sear for 3–4 minutes per side until blackened and beautiful. 5. Reduce the heat to medium-low, toss in 2 tbsp of butter and 4 minced garlic cloves. Let the butter melt and baste the chicken as it finishes cooking. Once fully cooked, remove and set aside. Resting = juicier chicken.  6. In the same pan (flavor central), for a little flair pour in ¼ cup of cooking and let it simmer for a minute to deglaze the pan. Melt the remaining butter (6 tablespoons) over medium heat. Add your minced garlic (6 to 8 cloves) and sauté for about 2 minutes.  7. Add 2 cups of room temperature heavy cream (important so it doesn’t curdle). Stir and bring it to a low simmer, then toss in your parmesan. Simmer for a couple of minutes while stirring until melted and smooth. As needed, loosen it with a bit of that reserved pasta water (I recommend around 1/3 cup) and simmer until your desired consistency is reached. 8. Add the cooked pasta directly to the sauce and toss to coat. Slice your rested chicken and lay it on top. Sprinkle with fresh parsley if you’re feeling fancy… or just extra parm if you’re feeling real. #pasta #recipe #recipesoftiktok #homecooking #alfredo #alfredosauce #parmesan #dinnerideas #dinner

tr: The tastiest high protein honey barbecue chicken and creamy garlic Parmesan potatoes. Only 580 calories, packed with so much flavour. So easy and perfect meal prep for the week. Slice your chicken breast into cubes. Season with garlic powder, smoked paprika, cumin, salt, black pepper and olive oil. If the colour doesn't change, it's not well seasoned. Next, slice your potatoes into small cubes just like this. Season them with salt, Italian herbs, smoked paprika, garlic and onion powder, grated Parmesan and optional olive oil. Give them a good mix. Then oven bake or air Fry for 20 minutes till beautifully golden. Now cook your chicken in light butter for 5 minutes per side till golden and crispy. Lower the heat, add a drizzle of honey barbecue sauce and fresh parsley. Give it a good mix till juicy and delicious. Then set the chicken aside. Add blended cottage cheese and milk with Italian herbs, garlic powder and Parmesan. Stir till smooth. Then drop your crispy potatoes. Mix till fully coated and indulgent. Finally serve with the honey barbecue chicken and your delicious high protein meals are ready to enjoy.

blog: SKLADNIKI: 1/4 cup honey | 1/2 tsp chili flakes | 1 tbsp soy sauce | 4 tbsp unsalted butter (divided) | 2 tbsp lemon juice | 1/3 cup water | 1 tsp cornstarch mixed with 1 tbsp water (slurry) | 4  salmon filets | Salt & pepper (to taste) | 4 tbsp olive oil || KROKI: In a saucepan over medium-low heat, combine honey, chili flakes, soy sauce, 3 tablespoons of butter, lemon juice, and water. Simmer for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove from heat and stir in the cornstarch slurry (ensure it's smooth and lump-free). Return to medium heat and simmer for another 5 minutes, or until the sauce thickens. Towards the end add the other 2 tbsp of cold butter. Transfer the sauce to a container to cool. Preheat your oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking tray with parchment paper. Arrange the salmon filets on the tray. Season with salt and pepper, then brush each filet with olive oil. Bake the salmon for 15 minutes. Remove from the oven, generously spoon 1-2 tablespoons of the hot honey sauce over each filet, letting some drip onto the tray for caramelization. Return to the oven and bake for an additional 5 minutes. Serve the hot honey salmon over a bed of steamed rice, drizzle with extra sauce, and garnish as desired. Enjoy the sweet and spicy perfection!
tr: If you mix butter, honey, chili flakes, soy sauce and lemon juice over medium heat and add a cornstarch water mixture to thicken it up, you'll have made a perfectly sweet and spicy hot honey sauce. All that's left to do is generously salt and pepper some salmon fillets and oil them up before baking in the oven at 400 Fahrenheit for 15 minutes. Cover each piece in the hot honey sauce and pop it back in the oven for five more minutes to let that sauce caramelize. cap: 📍ZAPISZ 🔽 PRZEPIS ✅ Lekka sałatka ziemniaczana na grill 🥗 Kochamy letni czas, słońce i pyszne jedzonko. Mamy więc dla Was przepis na sałatkę z pieczonymi ziemniakami i serem sałatkowym Kortos.  Świetnie sprawdzi się na piknik, grill czy lunch we dwoje🌱   Składniki - sałatka:  ⬛️ ok. 6-7 sztuk młodych ziemniaków ⬛️ 3 łyżki oliwy, 1 łyżeczka curry, 1 łyżeczka papryki słodkiej, 1/2 łyżeczki papryki ostrej, 1 łyżeczka oregano, 1 płaska łyżeczka soli ⬛️ Kortos ser sałatkowy typu greckiego ziołowy  ⬛️ 1 mała czerwona cebula  ⬛️ gałązka pomidorków koktajlowych (ok. 8-10 sztuk)  ⬛️ 2 garście zielonych listków (np. rukola, roszponka, sałata)  ⬛️ garść orzechów włoskich Większe ziemniaki kroimy w ćwiartki, a mniejsze w połówki.  Polewamy oliwą i przyprawiamy.  Pieczemy 40 min. w temp. 180 ℃. (góra/dół) Ser sałatkowy ziołowy Kortos kroimy w kostkę.  Można zrobić to już w opakowaniu, będzie jeszcze wygodniej.  Pomidorki przekrajamy na połówki. Cebulę kroimy w piórka. Wkładamy do miseczki z wodą, łyżeczką cukru i odstawiamy na kilka minut. Orzechy włoskie możemy podprażyć na suchej patelni przez kilka minut na niskiej mocy. Na talerzu układamy mix zielonych listków, pieczone ziemniaki, pomidorki i cebulę. Sałatkę polewamy sosem. Wykładamy kostki sera Kortos i posypujemy orzechami włoskimi. name: Cherry Tomato & Garlic Vodka Rigatoni
author: recipeincaption
cap: Cherry Tomato & Garlic Vodka Rigatoni ☀️  Minimal effort, max flavor. Sweet cherry tomatoes, garlic, cream, and a cheeky hit of vodka. Tip: Best served with chicken, sausage, or salmon 🫡 Ingredients: -2 tbsp butter -2 tbsp olive oil -1 large shallot, minced -8 garlic cloves, minced -2 cups cherry tomatoes, halved vertically -1 tsp salt (for the tomatoes) -2 tbsp tomato paste (optional but recommended) -1/2 cup vodka (optional) -1 cup heavy cream (can sub coconut milk or low fat), room temp -2/3 cup grated parmesan -8 oz (225g) pasta of your choice -1 tsp each: salt, black pepper, Italian seasoning, oregano, chili flakes -Fresh basil, for topping (optional but recommended) Instructions: 1. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook your pasta until al dente. Before draining, save a cup of that starchy pasta water (aka liquid gold). 2. In a large pan over medium-high heat, melt the butter and olive oil together. Once hot, toss in the minced shallots and sauté for 3 minutes until soft and fragrant. 3. Add the garlic and sauté for another minute. Then sprinkle in all your seasonings and let it toast for 1 more minute. 4. Add the halved cherry tomatoes and let them cook down for 8–10 minutes. Sprinkle in that extra teaspoon of salt. Smash them gently with a spoon or spatula as they soften. They should start to burst and get jammy. 5. Optional step: Remove from heat and blend about half the tomato mixture until smooth. You can do this in a blender or right in the pan with a handheld blender. Add 2 tbsp of tomato paste and stir everything together. 6. Add the vodka if using (try not to sip it unless it’s been one of those days) and cook it down over medium-low heat for 2–3 minutes until mostly evaporated. Drop the heat to low and stir in the cream, simmer gently for a few minutes. 7. Stir in the parmesan, fresh basil and cooked pasta, tossing it all together. If it looks dry, splash in some pasta water as hydration is key, for pasta AND life. 8. Taste, adjust seasonings if needed, and serve hot topped with basil and more parm if you’re feeling dramatic (and you should be). #recipe #dinnerideastiktok #dinner #pasta

cap: Cajun Chicken Pasta 🔥 Full extended written recipe with macros is in my bio 🫡 One pan, zero stress, all the flavor… creamy, garlicky, spicy Cajun goodness in every bite. -2 large chicken breasts, flattened -3 tbsp cajun seasoning (homemade blend below or store-bought) -1 medium yellow onion, diced -1 bell pepper, thinly sliced (I used ¼ each of red, orange, yellow & green for vibes ✨) -8 garlic cloves, minced -1 cup heavy cream, room temp (can sub: 1 cup cold milk + 1 tbsp cornstarch, whisked smooth) -5 tbsp butter -2 tbsp neutral oil (@algaecookingclub is my go-to) -1 cup fresh spinach -Extra seasoning boost: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp pepper, 1 tsp cayenne, 1 tsp Italian seasoning -¾ cup parmesan cheese, grated (freshly grated > pre-bagged, always) -½ cup pasta water (aka liquid gold) -8 oz (225 g) rigatoni -Fresh basil, for garnish (optional) Homemade Cajun Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 1 ½ tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, ½ tsp black pepper. ½ tsp Italian seasoning, ½ tsp salt, ½ tsp cayenne 1. Pat the chicken dry. Flatten slightly so it cooks evenly. Rub chicken with 1 tbsp olive oil and coat fully in Cajun until bronzed all over.  2. Bring a big pot of salted water to a boil. Cook pasta until al dente (box time minus 1 minute). Reserve a cup of pasta water (liquid gold), then drain & drizzle with olive oil to avoid clumping. 3. In a large pan over medium-high heat, add 2 tbsp neutral oil + 1 tbsp butter. Sear chicken 4 mins per side until golden. Lower heat, add 2 tbsp butter, and baste until cooked through. name: The easiest way to make the perfect hash brown. # Ingredients
author: cheffinwithzach
cap: The easiest way to make the perfect hash brown. # Ingredients - 4 medium russet potatoes (about 1¾ pounds), peeled - 1 teaspoon kosher salt, plus more to finish - Neutral oil, generous amount # Instructions 1. Grate the potatoes on the large holes of a box grater. Transfer to a large bowl, toss with the kosher salt, and let sit for 5–10 minutes. The salt will draw out moisture. 2. Transfer the shredded potato to a clean kitchen towel and squeeze out as much moisture as possible. Really wring it out — the drier the potato, the better the crust. 3. Add a generous layer of neutral oil to a 10-inch non-stick skillet over medium heat. Once the oil is shimmering, add the shredded potato and pack it firmly into an even layer with a spatula. 4. Cook until the bottom is deep golden brown, about 8–10 minutes. Swirl around in the pan for a more even cook. 5. To flip, place a plate larger than the pan over the pan, then invert both in one swift motion so the hash brown drops onto the plate. Add a little oil to the pan, then slide the hash brown back in, uncooked side down. Cook until the second side is equally golden, another 8–10 minutes. If the first side didn’t crisp up enough, flip it back and give it a few more minutes in the pan. 6. Season with salt immediately and serve.
tr: There are a thousand ways to crispify a potato, but it's the simple hash brown that I'll always come back to. Best way to consume a potato. First, you want russet potatoes. After peeling and grating, toss them with salt and let sit for five minutes to release extra moisture, which then you'll squeeze out. Water is the enemy of a shatteringly crisp hash brown. Every last drop. Then you fry in a generous amount of oil over a medium heat. A light sizzle is ideal. I press it down into an even layer, tucking those edges in. And I swirl the hash brown for a more even fry. Confidence. One swift motion will do the trick. Then you just fry the other side, and that's it. This is one of the easiest ways to transform a potato. And if you're hunting for a Sunday morning hangover cure or wanna impress that brunch, look no further. And by the way, the best way to eat this is with ketchup. Sorry. I don't make the rules. Hmm.

cap: Fakeaway Fish & Chips 🔥 Ingredients: For the Fish & Chips: - White fish fillets (cod, haddock, or pollock) - 1 cup all-purpose flour - 1/4 cup cornflour - 1 tsp baking powder - 1/2 tsp salt - 1/2 tsp paprika (optional) - 1 cup cold beer or sparkling water - Vegetable oil, for frying - Large potatoes, peeled and cut into thick chips For the Tartare Sauce: - 4 tbsp mayonnaise - 2 tsp capers, chopped - 2 small gherkins, finely chopped - 1 tsp Dijon mustard - 1 tbsp lemon juice - 1 tbsp fresh parsley, chopped - Salt and pepper, to taste Instructions: Prepare the Chips: Peel and cut the potatoes into thick chips. Parboil the chips in salted boiling water for 5-7 minutes, then drain and let them dry completely on a wire rack. Heat vegetable oil in a deep pan or fryer to 160°C (320°F). Fry the chips in batches for 4-5 minutes until pale and soft but not golden. Remove and drain on paper towels. Increase the oil temperature to 190°C (375°F). Fry the chips a second time for 2-3 minutes until golden and crispy. Drain again and sprinkle with salt. Make the Tartare Sauce: Combine mayonnaise, capers, gherkins, mustard, lemon juice, parsley, salt, and pepper. Mix well and refrigerate until serving. Prepare the Batter: In a mixing bowl, combine flour, cornflour, baking powder, salt, and paprika (if using). Gradually whisk in the beer or sparkling water until smooth. Coat and Fry the Fish: Pat the fish fillets dry with kitchen paper and lightly dust with flour and salt. Dip into the batter, coating completely. Heat the oil to 180°C (350°F). Fry the fish for 4-6 minutes until golden and crispy. Remove and drain on paper towels. Serve: Serve the crispy fish with double-fried chips, tartare sauce, and lemon wedges.  #FishAndChips #DoubleFriedChips  #BritishClassics  #CrispyFish  #FakeawayRecipe

name: Salad does NOT have to be boring! Here’s a creamy, spicy, Greek style
author: raziyyz
cap:
Salad does NOT have to be boring! Here’s a creamy, spicy, Greek style Chicken Salad. A low carb option that’s great for meal prepping, PACKED with flavour, protein, and done in 20 minutes.👇🏼
-
Chicken:
• 2-3 chicken breast (approx 300g total)
• 1 tsp olive oil
• season with salt, pepper, paprika, garlic powder and oregano
-
Dressing:
• 3/4 cup fat free greek yogurt
• 1-2 tbsp hot sauce
• 1 tbsp minced garlic
• squeeze of lemon (I used half a lemon, and add zest from lemon peel if possible)
• salt and pepper (to taste)
• 1/2 tsp dill
• water (to thin out dressing, about 2 tbsp or to your liking)
-
Salad:
• 2 hearts romaine lettuce, chopped (approx. 250g of lettuce)
• 1 cup chopped tomatoes (I used cherry tomatoes)
• 1 cup chopped cucumbers
• 1 red onion, slices
• 1/4 cup black olives (optional)
• 2 tbsp feta cheese (optional)
-
Notes:
• I like to also add some crushed chili flakes for an extra spice kick
• If you plan to meal prep, keep the sauce and salad separate and mix when ready to serve.
• This recipe is great to double and make in batches for the week. Eat it straight out of your tupperware and no need for any kind of reheating. Easy as it gets!
• You can add/remove your veggies of choice! For example, you can switch out lettuce for spinach.

name: An easy, healthier substitute for Ice Cream… Blueberry Cheesecake flav
author: raziyyz
cap:
An easy, healthier substitute for Ice Cream… Blueberry Cheesecake flavour! The hype is real with this cottage cheese hack. 6 ingredients, creamy, low calorie and PACKED with protein.👇🏼
-
Cream Mix:
• 2 cups (16oz) cottage cheese (I use 2-4% fat)
• 3 tbsp light cream cheese
• 1/4 cup low calorie maple syrup OR any sweetener
• 1 scoop vanilla protein powder (I use myprotein whey)
• Optional: 1/4 tsp salt
-
Blueberry Mix:
• 1 cup frozen blueberries
• 1 tsp honey OR any sweetener
-
Directions:
• Add all “cream mix” ingredients to blender and blend until smooth
• Add “blueberry mix” to medium heat pot/pan and cook into jam
• Add half of cream mix to jar/container, followed by half blueberry mix. Repeat twice for two layers.
• using a fork/knife, swirl the blueberry mix to create an even flavour.
• Freeze for 3 hours and serve.
-
Notes:
• The higher fat content of cottage cheese you have, the less your mix will freeze solid after placing it in the freezer for longer than 3 hours. Even if it does, you just need to leave it out to thaw for a few minutes and mix it around before serving.
• You can use greek yogurt as a substitute for cottage cheese, but I recommend keeping it for the cheesecake flavour.
• You can experiment with all different kinds of frozen fruits. I also love using raspberries.
• Add your toppings of choice for an extra crunch!
-
Serving Size: 3

• 29g Protein

author: alexcookjoy
cap: This one earns its spot weekly 🥢Teriyaki Chicken Stir Fry ■ INGREDIENTS For the chicken: • 2 large chicken breasts (about 1.2 lbs / 550 g), thinly sliced • 1 tbsp cornstarch (8 g) • salt & black pepper • 1 tbsp vegetable oil (15 ml) For the vegetables: • 1 red bell pepper, sliced (120 g) • 1 cup broccoli florets (100 g) • 1 small carrot, thin strips (70 g) • ½ small white onion, sliced (60 g) • 2 green onions, chopped • ½ cup unsalted cashews (70 g) (optional) For the teriyaki sauce: • ¼ cup soy sauce (60 ml) • 3 tbsp cold water (45 ml) • 2 tbsp honey or brown sugar (30 g) • 1 tbsp rice vinegar (15 ml) • 1 tbsp sesame oil (15 ml) • 2 cloves garlic, minced • 1 tsp grated ginger • 1 tbsp cornstarch (8 g) To serve: • cooked jasmine rice or noodles • sesame seeds • extra green onion ■ HOW TO COOK: 1. Season sliced chicken with salt & pepper. Toss with 1 tbsp cornstarch. 2. Whisk soy sauce, water, honey, rice vinegar, sesame oil, garlic, ginger, and cornstarch. Set aside. 3. Add cashews to a dry pan and toast 2–3 minutes until golden (optional). Remove. 4. Heat oil in a pan over medium-high (375°F / 190°C). Add chicken and stir-fry 5–6 minutes until golden. Remove to a plate. 5. Add bell pepper, broccoli, carrot, and white onion. Cook 3–4 minutes until crisp-tender. 6. Return chicken. Pour in the teriyaki sauce. Stir 1–2 minutes until the sauce thickens and becomes glossy. 7. Add green onions + toasted cashews (if using). Toss and remove from heat. ■ INFO (approx.): Prep: 10 min  Cook: 15 min  Total: ~25 min Makes: 2 servings 650 kcal | 50 g protein | 17 g fat | 70 g carbs (per serving) #teriyaki #stirfry #chickenrecipe #chickenrecipes #dinnerideas

name: Creamy, Chocolate Strawberry Overnight Oats. Low calorie, PACKED with
author: raziyyz
cap:
Creamy, Chocolate Strawberry Overnight Oats. Low calorie, PACKED with protein, so delicious and easy to make. Prep it in 5 minutes!👇🏼
-
Ingredients:
• 1/2 cup fat free greek yogurt, plain
• 1/3 cup rolled oats
• 1/4 cup any milk (I use 1%)
• 1 tsp sweetener or honey (I use low calorie maple syrup)
• 1 scoop protein powder (I use myprotein vanilla whey)
• 1/2 cup chopped strawberries
• melted dark chocolate (1 heaping tbsp dark chocolate chips + 1 tsp coconut oil microwaved for 45 seconds)
-
Directions:
• In a mason jar (16 oz. or larger), add all ingredients except melted dark chocolate. Mix well.
• Add 1 heaping tbsp dark chocolate chips and 1 tsp coconut oil into a bowl, and microwave for 30-45 seconds and mix until melted completely. You can also heat in a bowl over a hot pot of water.
• Pour thin layer of melted chocolate on top of overnight oats.
• Seal tight and refrigerate for 3-4 hours or overnight.
-
Notes:
• You are more than welcome to simple add chocolate chips into the mix instead of melting it as a topping. It will give you a different type experience though!
• These can last in the fridge for up to 5 days, so feel free to make them in large batches!
• Add any extra toppings you like, but be mindful of calories!

name: Mc chicken sandwich
author: iramsfoodstory
cap:
Mc chicken sandwich 🍔 

Ingredients 

For the chicken patty:

2 lb boneless chicken breast, minced 
Salt and pepper to taste
1 tbsp garlic powder 
1 tbsp onion powder 
Oil for frying 

For the chicken patty coating:

8 tbsp all purpose flour 
Salt and pepper to taste 
1 tsp garlic powder 
1 tsp onion powder 
1/3 cup water 

For the sauce

1 cup mayonnaise 
2 tbsp Dijon mustard 
Salt and pepper to taste 
1 tsp white vinegar 

To assemble:

Brioche buns
Lettuce, diced 

Method:

In a mixing bowl combine minced chicken. Season with salt, pepper, garlic and onion powder. Mix well until combined.

Grease hands with a little bit oil and make round patties. Place them onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, and let them freeze for 30 minutes or until ready to use.

Take two dishes, divide the all purpose flour in both dishes( around 4 tbsp each). Add salt pepper, garlic and onion powder in one bowl, Along with water to make a thick batter. Adjust water accordingly. 

Heat oil in a frying pan. Once the oil is hot,

Coat the chicken patties in flour mixture then the wet batter. Carefully drop the chicken patties into the oil. Fry on medium low for 10-15 minutes or until fully cooked and crispy golden brown.

Make sauce by combining mayo, Dijon mustard, salt pepper and vinegar in a mixing bowl. 

Assemble the sandwich by adding sauce, chicken patty, lettuce and some more sauce. Serve with some fries and enjoy!

name: spaghetti all’assassina
author: America’s Test Kitchen
cap: Making spaghetti all’assassina requires patience and bravery—and a blatant disregard of the rules. #howto #easyrecipe #pasta
tr: Spaghetti alla assasin, the pasta dish you burn on purpose. Hailing from Bari, Italy, Assasin is simmered, then crisped and charred. The pasta is soft and tender in some spots and caramelized and crunchy in others. And it's all coated in a super concentrated and spicy tomato sauce. Here's how you make it. Heat extra virgin olive oil in a large skillet with garlic and chili flakes. Add a few glugs of passata di pomodoro and simmer vigorously to reduce. Add dry spaghetti and top it with about a cup of broth made with tomato paste and water. Let the strands sit in the bubbling liquid to drink it up and start to soften. Then ladle in more broth each time the pan threatens to dry out. It's like risotto, the method used for making risotto. Keep adding broth, turning the spaghetti over and reducing the sauce until the strands are cooked through. Finally, increase the heat so the pasta at the bottom of the pan crisps, caramelizes, and scorches. Pull the spaghetti from the stove, twirl it onto a plate, and adorn the deliciously, deeply satisfying tangle with a drizzle of your very best extra virgin olive oil. Ciao!

name: Justice for @Andy Cooks
author: netshaq
cap: Justice for @Andy Cooks —  If you’re a lazy cook, try the untouched brick method
tr: I saw this video about how to cook ground beef so it doesn't turn gray and soupy in the pan. This guy is right. The directions given are correct, all the comments insist that they'd never perform that much effort for ground beef in cooking. Since effort and quality lie on a wide spectrum, here's what I propose as a middle ground Chuck the whole brick of 80 20 beef in a hot pan, add salt, and leave it alone. Matter of fact, go ahead and try to burn it. You can't. The fat that comes out of the beef will fry that surface to a dark brown color even if you just leave it there. Now flip it over and do it again. By the time both sides are dark brown, a good amount of water has evaporated off the meat, so now you can break it down into crumbles, get it all crispy, cut the heat, and add all the rest of the seasonings. Obviously there are ways to improve this technique, but for all the folks who want to strike a balance between low effort and high quality, give the untouched brick method a shot.

author: seattlehanddoc

author: jalalsamfit
cap: High Protein Sticky Korean Fried Chicken! Only 452 Calories. This has to be one of the best chicken & rice recipes, so much flavor, the perfect balance of sweet, spicy & savoury! Macros per serve (4 total) 452 Calories | 40g Protein | 51g Carbs | 10g Fat Ingredients (4 servings) - 700-800g Cubed Chicken Breast - 2 tsp Garlic Powder - 1.5 tsp Black Pepper - 2 tsp Paprika - 1 tsp Salt - 30g Cornflour For the Glaze - 50ml Light Soy sauce mixed with 50ml Water (total 100ml) - 25g Honey - 40g Gochujang Paste Pickled Cucumbers - Thinly sliced Cucumber - 20ml Light Soy Sauce - 10ml Rice Vinegar - OPTIONAL Chilli Flakes - 1 tsp Garlic Powder - 1 tsp Sesame Seeds Important cooking notes - When coating the chicken with cornflour makes sure it's well coated. - When making the glaze, add the ingredients on low heat then keep stirring till it starts to bubble lightly then let it reduce for 3-4 mins. It should thicken - You can store the cucumbers separately and warm up the meal prep without them.
name: Sticky Korean Fried Chicken

author: thisisplanetfood
cap: CHEESY TIGER GARLIC BREAD! Recipe: Preheat your oven to 200C/180C fan. To make your garlic butter, mix together 250g softened butter, 2 tbsp olive oil, 8 finely chopped garlic cloves, 1 tsp parsley, 1/2 tsp salt and 1 tbsp parmesan. Cut slices into your tiger bread - around 2cm apart but do not cut all the way through to the bottom of the loaf. Smother the garlic butter into the bread slices and all over the top. Fill the bread slices with mozzarella slices as well as on top. Wrap the loaf in foil and bake in the oven for 15 minutes until the butter has melted and cheese is golden.
name: Cheesy Tiger Garlic Bread

cap: Blueberry Jam. Ingredients - 1kg blueberries, 200g sugar, 60ml apple cider vinegar, 1 tsp fennel pollen (star anise also works great). Method 1. Wash the berries well and then drain. Place the berries into a bowl with the sugar and mix well. Cover with a tea towel and leave at room temperature for 3-4 hours. 2. Place the berries and any liquid into a large pot. Bring to a simmer, then cook on medium-low until it thickens, about 2 hours. 3. Sterilise your jam jars by boiling them for 5 to 10 minutes. Pour the hot jam into the jars. 4. The jam will last up to 6 months unopened.
name: Blueberry Jam

cap: Honey Buffalo Chicken Mac & Cheese! Easy High Protein Meal Prep (Per Serve - 4 Total) 512 Calories 43gC | 12gF | 79.5gP. Steps: 1. Season diced chicken. 2. Add all of the ingredients for the mac & cheese sauce into a blender cup then blend for 2 minutes until smooth and creamy. 3. Prepare 320g of uncooked pasta. 4. cap: Here's a classic brownie recipe for you: Ingredients: 1 cup (225g) unsalted butter, 2 cups (400g) granulated sugar, 4 large eggs, 1 teaspoon vanilla extract, 3/4 cup (90g) unsweetened cocoa powder, 1 cup (125g) all-purpose flour, 1/2 teaspoon salt, optional 1 cup (175g) chocolate chips. Instructions: 1. Preheat your oven to 350F (175C) and grease a 9x13 inch baking pan. 2. In a medium saucepan, melt the butter over low heat. Remove from heat and stir in sugar, eggs, and vanilla extract. 3. Beat in cocoa, flour, and salt until just blended. 4. Spread the batter into the prepared pan. 5. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes. 6. Let the brownies cool before cutting.
name: Classic brownie
